note: Team-created demo consumer applications prepared for private GitHub repositories. They are not Stripe customers or Stripe applications. Nothing here has been created, pushed or installed on GitHub; destination owner is set only when the operating user authorizes publication (see demo/GITHUB_SETUP.md).

repositories.name: shockwave-stripe-checkout
repositories.demonstrates: USD display divides response.amount by 100 (affected); basis-points / 100 tax note and a local loyalty reward amount (unrelated controls)

repositories.name: shockwave-stripe-fraud
repositories.demonstrates: manual review when response.amount > 500000 (USD $5,000 in cents; affected); velocity limit with a local 'amount' count (unrelated control)

repositories.name: shockwave-stripe-reporting
repositories.demonstrates: currency/status summary (unaffected control, executed against both variants); ledger stores response.amount in an amount_minor column (potential storage risk, not executed); local Budget.amount (unrelated control)
